entry.name: rnbo_urn
entry.description: Outputs random numbers and keeps track of each number that has been generated. When all numbers up to the maximum (set via an argument or the right inlet) have been output, a bang is send out the right outlet.

arguments.name: size
arguments.description: Sets the range of possible output values. Output values are 0 indexed. Changing this value will clear the internal array of used numbers.

arguments.name: seed
arguments.description: Sets a seed state for the random values, so that randomized results will be predictable each time the code is run.
